en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To gain knowledge of viral nad bacterial pathogens, their diagnostics. To gain skills in control of these pathogens.

en.content: 1.Common agricultural virology (allowance 4/14) a.Virus morphology, replication, transmissionb.Taxonomy of plant virus pathogensc.Basis of plant virus diagnostics2.Special agricultural virology (allowance 10/0) a.Virus pathogens of field cropsb.Virus pathogens of fruits, vegetables and greenhouse cultures3.Common agricultural bacteriology (allowance 6/14) a.Procaryotes morphology, structure of bacterial cells,nutrition and metabolism, replicationb.Taxonomy of bacterial pathogens of plantsc.Basis of plant bacteria diagnostics4.Special agricultural bacteriology (allowance 8/0) a.Bacterial pathogens of field cropsb.Bacterial pathogens of fruits, vegetables and greenhouse cultures
